cohort: The study included 23 men initiating testosterone undecanoate (13 hypogonadal cisgender, 10 transgender), 15 men on steady-state TU (10 hypogonadal cisgender, 5 transgender), and a control group of 32 eugonadal cisgender men.
finding: After 12 months of testosterone undecanoate treatment, naive transgender men showed increased hemoglobin and hematocrit to cisgender male reference levels and a slight decrease in HDL-cholesterol, while liver enzymes remained unchanged.
